raw_text: Breaking: DRDO internal research network targeted by state-sponsored APT group through supply chain attack. Third-party IT vendor compromised to deliver custom malware disguised as software update for lab management systems. NIA launching investigation. Initial forensics point to South Asian nation-state threat actor. #DRDO #CyberEspionage #APT
clean_text: DRDO research network targeted via supply chain attack. Third-party vendor compromised with malware disguised as lab software update. NIA investigating. South Asian APT suspected.
